description: "When Hearts are Trumps" by Tom Hall is a compilation of poetry and verses published during the late 19th century (specifically the 1890s). This collection primarily explores themes of love, desire, and the complexities of relationships, using rich imagery and playful language to convey the emotions associated with romantic encounters.
